narrative:
Net interest income is planned at EUR 132M across six interest-bearing products, broadly flat versus FY2025 (EUR 131M). The NII tailwind of 2023-24 has ended: the ECB deposit rate sits at 2.00% and 12M Euribor near 2.1%, so margin management — not rate rises — now drives NII.

Two levers dominate. On the asset side, the 2021-22 mortgage vintage reprices at renewal with new-lending margins 8bp above the back book. On the liability side, corporate operating deposits show a cumulative beta of 24% versus 45% on savings, leaving room for tiered pricing.

Net interest margin is modelled at 1.71%, down 14bp. The agents propose mortgage repricing, Cash Management deposit pricing and a Helsinki corporate-lending uplift — together worth about EUR 3M of NII.

signals.title: ECB Easing Path — Deposit Rate at 2.00%
signals.excerpt: Markets price a flat deposit rate through 2026. 12M Euribor stabilised near 2.1%, ending the NII tailwind that lifted Finnish banks in 2023-24.

signals.title: Aktia Strategy 2026 — Efficiency & Wealth Growth
signals.excerpt: Board reconfirms financial targets: cost-to-income below 60% and ROE above 12%. Growth priority is wealth management; banking services to be developed through digital channels.
